name: Lococonanaco
source:
Neo-fennec no. 655775. Works at a Hawaiian bar on Cosmic Oahu.

She possesses uniquely long arms due to her strong “Adam blood,” a term reserved for apparent traits from early neo-fennec ancestors.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051110]Steam[/url]]
